name: Netskope - Application Detail - New
description: Application Details Dashboard provides a high-level view of data for unique applications used, as well as top applications by alerts, bytes, and average page duration. This dashboard also provides a visual breakdown of applications by category, devices by user access, and network usage over time.
title: Netskope - Application Detail - New

queries.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Netskope "page"
| json "_id", "alert", "app_session_id", "browser", "bypass_traffic", "client_bytes", "appcategory", "app", "os", "user", "device", "domain", "http_transaction_count","num_bytes","server_bytes", "site", "timestamp", "ccl", "traffic_type", "type", "url", "page", "page_duration", "hostname", "req_cnt", "resp_cnt" as event_id, alert, app_session_id, browser, bypass_traffic, client_bytes, appcategory, app, os, user, device, domain, http_transaction_count,num_bytes,server_bytes, site, timestamp, ccl, traffic_type, type, url, page, page_duration, hostname, req_cnt, resp_cnt nodrop
| where isNull(alert) and type="page" and !isNull({{GROUP_BY_FIELD}})
| if(isNull(appcategory), "unknown", appcategory) as appcategory
|where if ("{{browser}}" = "*", true, browser matches "{{browser}}") AND if ("{{os}}" = "*", true, os matches "{{os}}") AND if ("{{device}}" = "*", true, device matches "{{device}}") AND if ("{{src_ip}}" = "*", true, src_ip matches "{{src_ip}}") AND if ("{{dest_ip}}" = "*", true, dest_ip matches "{{dest_ip}}") AND if ("{{appcategory}}" = "*", true, appcategory matches "{{appcategory}}") AND if ("{{app}}" = "*", true, app matches "{{app}}")
|count_distinct({{GROUP_BY_FIELD}}) by appcategory
| sort by _count_distinct

_sourceCategory = Labs/Netskope "page"
| json "_id", "alert", "app_session_id", "browser", "bypass_traffic", "client_bytes", "appcategory", "app", "os", "user", "device", "domain", "http_transaction_count","num_bytes","server_bytes", "site", "timestamp", "ccl", "traffic_type", "type", "url", "page", "page_duration", "hostname", "req_cnt", "resp_cnt", "useragent" as event_id, alert, app_session_id, browser, bypass_traffic, client_bytes, appcategory, app, os, user, device, domain, http_transaction_count,num_bytes,server_bytes, site, timestamp, ccl, traffic_type, type, url, page, page_duration, hostname, req_cnt, resp_cnt, useragent nodrop
| where isNull(alert) and type="page"
|where if ("{{browser}}" = "*", true, browser matches "{{browser}}") AND if ("{{os}}" = "*", true, os matches "{{os}}") AND if ("{{device}}" = "*", true, device matches "{{device}}") AND if ("{{src_ip}}" = "*", true, src_ip matches "{{src_ip}}") AND if ("{{dest_ip}}" = "*", true, dest_ip matches "{{dest_ip}}") AND if ("{{appcategory}}" = "*", true, appcategory matches "{{appcategory}}") AND if ("{{app}}" = "*", true, app matches "{{app}}")
|count by useragent

_sourceCategory = Labs/Netskope "page"
| json "_id", "alert", "app_session_id", "browser", "bypass_traffic", "client_bytes", "appcategory", "app", "os", "user", "device", "domain", "http_transaction_count","num_bytes","server_bytes", "site", "timestamp", "ccl", "traffic_type", "type", "url", "page", "page_duration", "hostname", "req_cnt", "resp_cnt" as event_id, alert, app_session_id, browser, bypass_traffic, client_bytes, appcategory, app, os, user, device, domain, http_transaction_count,num_bytes,server_bytes, site, timestamp, ccl, traffic_type, type, url, page, page_duration, hostname, req_cnt, resp_cnt nodrop
| where isNull(alert) and type="page" and !isNull({{GROUP_BY_FIELD}})
|where if ("{{browser}}" = "*", true, browser matches "{{browser}}") AND if ("{{os}}" = "*", true, os matches "{{os}}") AND if ("{{device}}" = "*", true, device matches "{{device}}") AND if ("{{src_ip}}" = "*", true, src_ip matches "{{src_ip}}") AND if ("{{dest_ip}}" = "*", true, dest_ip matches "{{dest_ip}}") AND if ("{{appcategory}}" = "*", true, appcategory matches "{{appcategory}}") AND if ("{{app}}" = "*", true, app matches "{{app}}")
|count by {{GROUP_BY_FIELD}}, appcategory, ccl, client_bytes, server_bytes, user, app_session_id, page_duration
| sum(client_bytes) as upload_bytes, sum(server_bytes) as download_bytes, count(user) as user_count, count(app_session_id) as session_count, avg(page_duration) as avg_page_duration by {{GROUP_BY_FIELD}}, appcategory, ccl
| upload_bytes/1024/1024 as upload_bytes_MB
| download_bytes/1024/1024 as download_bytes_sumMB
| upload_bytes_MB+download_bytes_sumMB as total_bytes_sumMB
| fields -upload_bytes, download_bytes
| sort by {{SORT_BY}}
| limit 10
|where if ("{{download_bytes_sumMB}}" = "> -2147483648", true, download_bytes_sumMB {{download_bytes_sumMB}}) AND if ("{{total_bytes_sumMB}}" = "> -2147483648", true, total_bytes_sumMB {{total_bytes_sumMB}})

panels.title: Top 10 Applications by Avg Page Duration

queries.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Netskope "page"
| json "_id", "alert", "app_session_id", "browser", "bypass_traffic", "client_bytes", "appcategory", "app", "os", "user", "device", "domain", "http_transaction_count","num_bytes","server_bytes", "site", "timestamp", "ccl", "traffic_type", "type", "url", "page", "page_duration", "hostname", "req_cnt", "resp_cnt" as event_id, alert, app_session_id, browser, bypass_traffic, client_bytes, appcategory, app, os, user, device, domain, http_transaction_count,num_bytes,server_bytes, site, timestamp, ccl, traffic_type, type, url, page, page_duration, hostname, req_cnt, resp_cnt nodrop
| where isNull(alert) and type="page" and !isNull({{GROUP_BY_FIELD}})
|where if ("{{browser}}" = "*", true, browser matches "{{browser}}") AND if ("{{os}}" = "*", true, os matches "{{os}}") AND if ("{{device}}" = "*", true, device matches "{{device}}") AND if ("{{src_ip}}" = "*", true, src_ip matches "{{src_ip}}") AND if ("{{dest_ip}}" = "*", true, dest_ip matches "{{dest_ip}}") AND if ("{{appcategory}}" = "*", true, appcategory matches "{{appcategory}}") AND if ("{{app}}" = "*", true, app matches "{{app}}")
|avg(page_duration) as average_page_duration by {{GROUP_BY_FIELD}}
| top 10 {{GROUP_BY_FIELD}} by average_page_duration

_sourceCategory = Labs/Netskope "nspolicy" "no" 
| json "_id", "alert", "alert_type", "type", "srcip", "dstip", "appcategory", "app", "os", "user", "device", "acked", "site", "timestamp", "ccl", "activity", "browser", "object", "object_type", "from_user", "to_user" as alert_id, is_alert, alert_type, type, src_ip, dest_ip, appcategory, app, os, user, device, acked, site, timestamp, ccl, activity, browser, object, object_type, from_user, to_user nodrop| where is_alert="no" and isNull(alert_type) and type="nspolicy"
| if(isNull(activity), "Unknown", activity) as activity
|where if ("{{browser}}" = "*", true, browser matches "{{browser}}") AND if ("{{os}}" = "*", true, os matches "{{os}}") AND if ("{{activity}}" = "*", true, activity matches "{{activity}}") AND if ("{{device}}" = "*", true, device matches "{{device}}") AND if ("{{src_ip}}" = "*", true, src_ip matches "{{src_ip}}") AND if ("{{dest_ip}}" = "*", true, dest_ip matches "{{dest_ip}}") AND if ("{{appcategory}}" = "*", true, appcategory matches "{{appcategory}}") AND if ("{{app}}" = "*", true, app matches "{{app}}")
|count by activity, app
| total _count as activity_count by app
| transpose row app, activity_count column activity
| sort by activity_count

panels.title: How to use sort by and group by filters?
panels.text:
* Use SORT BY filter for sorting applications in Top 10 Applications panel by  one of the following columns: session_count, user_count, avg_page_duration, download_bytes_sumMB, upload_bytes_sumMB, total_bytes_sumMB.The default option is:  total_bytes
* Use GROUP BY FIELD filter to group by SiteName(site) or by AppName(app). The default option is AppName.

_sourceCategory = Labs/Netskope "page"
| json "_id", "alert", "app_session_id", "browser", "bypass_traffic", "client_bytes", "appcategory", "app", "os", "user", "device", "domain", "http_transaction_count","num_bytes","server_bytes", "site", "timestamp", "ccl", "traffic_type", "type", "url", "page", "page_duration", "hostname", "req_cnt", "resp_cnt" as event_id, is_alert, app_session_id, browser, bypass_traffic, client_bytes, appcategory, app, os, user, device, domain, http_transaction_count,num_bytes,server_bytes, site, timestamp, ccl, traffic_type, type, url, page, page_duration, hostname, req_cnt, resp_cnt nodrop
| where isNull(is_alert) and type="page" and !isNull({{GROUP_BY_FIELD}})
|where if ("{{browser}}" = "*", true, browser matches "{{browser}}") AND if ("{{os}}" = "*", true, os matches "{{os}}") AND if ("{{device}}" = "*", true, device matches "{{device}}") AND if ("{{src_ip}}" = "*", true, src_ip matches "{{src_ip}}") AND if ("{{dest_ip}}" = "*", true, dest_ip matches "{{dest_ip}}") AND if ("{{appcategory}}" = "*", true, appcategory matches "{{appcategory}}") AND if ("{{app}}" = "*", true, app matches "{{app}}")

_sourceCategory = Labs/Netskope "page"
| json "_id", "alert", "app_session_id", "browser", "bypass_traffic", "client_bytes", "appcategory", "app", "os", "user", "device", "domain", "http_transaction_count","num_bytes","server_bytes", "site", "timestamp", "ccl", "traffic_type", "type", "url", "page", "page_duration", "hostname", "req_cnt", "resp_cnt" as event_id, alert, app_session_id, browser, bypass_traffic, client_bytes, appcategory, app, os, user, device, domain, http_transaction_count,num_bytes,server_bytes, site, timestamp, ccl, traffic_type, type, url, page, page_duration, hostname, req_cnt, resp_cnt nodrop
| where isNull(alert) and type="page" and !isNull(app)
| timeslice 1h
|where if ("{{browser}}" = "*", true, browser matches "{{browser}}") AND if ("{{os}}" = "*", true, os matches "{{os}}") AND if ("{{device}}" = "*", true, device matches "{{device}}") AND if ("{{src_ip}}" = "*", true, src_ip matches "{{src_ip}}") AND if ("{{dest_ip}}" = "*", true, dest_ip matches "{{dest_ip}}") AND if ("{{appcategory}}" = "*", true, appcategory matches "{{appcategory}}") AND if ("{{app}}" = "*", true, app matches "{{app}}")
|sum(client_bytes) as upload_bytes, sum(server_bytes) as download_bytes by _timeslice
| upload_bytes/1024/1024 as upload_bytes_sumMB
| download_bytes/1024/1024 as download_bytes_sumMB
| upload_bytes_sumMB+download_bytes_sumMB as total_bytes_sumMB
| fields -upload_bytes, download_bytes
|where if ("{{download_bytes_sumMB}}" = "> -2147483648", true, download_bytes_sumMB {{download_bytes_sumMB}}) AND if ("{{total_bytes_sumMB}}" = "> -2147483648", true, total_bytes_sumMB {{total_bytes_sumMB}}) AND if ("{{upload_bytes_sumMB}}" = "> -2147483648", true, upload_bytes_sumMB {{upload_bytes_sumMB}})

_sourceCategory = Labs/Netskope "nspolicy" "no"
| json "_id", "alert", "alert_type","type", "srcip", "dstip", "appcategory", "app", "os", "user", "device", "acked", "site", "timestamp", "ccl", "activity", "browser", "object", "object_type", "from_user", "to_user" as alert_id, is_alert, alert_type, type, src_ip, dest_ip, appcategory, app, os, user, device, acked, site, timestamp, ccl, activity, browser, object, object_type, from_user, to_user nodrop
| where is_alert="no" and isNull(alert_type) and type="nspolicy"
|where if ("{{browser}}" = "*", true, browser matches "{{browser}}") AND if ("{{os}}" = "*", true, os matches "{{os}}") AND if ("{{activity}}" = "*", true, activity matches "{{activity}}") AND if ("{{device}}" = "*", true, device matches "{{device}}") AND if ("{{src_ip}}" = "*", true, src_ip matches "{{src_ip}}") AND if ("{{dest_ip}}" = "*", true, dest_ip matches "{{dest_ip}}") AND if ("{{appcategory}}" = "*", true, appcategory matches "{{appcategory}}") AND if ("{{app}}" = "*", true, app matches "{{app}}")
|count by device
| top 10 device by _count

_sourceCategory = Labs/Netskope ("DLP" OR "anomaly" OR "Malware" OR "Compromised Credentials") "yes" 
| json "_id", "srcip", "dstip", "alert", "alert_name", "alert_type", "appcategory", "category", "app", "site", "os", "user", "device", "acked" as alert_id, src_ip, dest_ip, is_alert, alert_name, alert_type, appcategory, category, app, site, os, user, device, acked nodrop
| where is_alert="yes" and alert_type in ("DLP", "anomaly", "Malware", "Compromised Credentials")
|where if ("{{os}}" = "*", true, os matches "{{os}}") AND if ("{{device}}" = "*", true, device matches "{{device}}") AND if ("{{src_ip}}" = "*", true, src_ip matches "{{src_ip}}") AND if ("{{dest_ip}}" = "*", true, dest_ip matches "{{dest_ip}}") AND if ("{{appcategory}}" = "*", true, appcategory matches "{{appcategory}}") AND if ("{{app}}" = "*", true, app matches "{{app}}")
|count by alert_type, {{GROUP_BY_FIELD}}
| total _count as total_alerts by {{GROUP_BY_FIELD}}
| transpose row {{GROUP_BY_FIELD}}, total_alerts column alert_type
| sort by total_alerts
| limit 10
